verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אַחֲרֵ֣י מ֔וֹת שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן בְּקָרְבָתָ֥ם לִפְנֵי־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיָּמֻֽתוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh ’a·ḥă·rê mō·wṯ šə·nê bə·nê ’a·hă·rōn bə·qā·rə·ḇā·ṯām lip̄·nê- Yah·weh way·yā·mu·ṯū
verses.literal: Now the LORD spoke to Moses after the death of two of Aaron’s sons when they approached the presence of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E FALOU o SENHOR a Moisés, depois da morte dos dois filhos de Arão, que morreram quando se chegaram diante do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה דַּבֵּר֮ אֶל־ אַהֲרֹ֣ן אָחִיךָ֒ וְאַל־ יָבֹ֤א בְכָל־ עֵת֙ אֶל־ הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ מִבֵּ֖ית לַפָּרֹ֑כֶת אֶל־ פְּנֵ֨י הַכַּפֹּ֜רֶת אֲשֶׁ֤ר עַל־ הָאָרֹן֙ וְלֹ֣א יָמ֔וּת כִּ֚י בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן אֵרָאֶ֖ה עַל־ הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh dab·bêr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn ’ā·ḥî·ḵā wə·’al- yā·ḇō ḇə·ḵāl- ‘êṯ ’el- haq·qō·ḏeš mib·bêṯ lap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ ’el- pə·nê hak·kap·pō·reṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- hā·’ā·rōn wə·lō yā·mūṯ kî be·‘ā·nān ’ê·rā·’eh ‘al- hak·kap·pō·reṯ
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses Tell your brother Aaron not to enter freely . . . into the Most Holy Place behind the veil in front of the mercy seat on the ark or else he will die because I appear in the cloud above the mercy seat
verses.literalPt: Disse, pois, o SENHOR a Moisés: Dize a Arão, teu irmão, que não entre no santuário em todo o tempo, para dentro do véu, diante do propiciatório que está sobre a arca, para que não morra; porque eu aparecerei na nuvem sobre o propiciatório.

verses.original: בְּזֹ֛את יָבֹ֥א אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶל־ הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ בְּפַ֧ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֛ר לְחַטָּ֖את וְאַ֥יִל לְעֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·zōṯ yā·ḇō ’a·hă·rōn ’el- haq·qō·ḏeš bə·p̄ar ben- bā·qār lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·’a·yil lə·‘ō·lāh
verses.literal: This is how Aaron is to enter . . . the Holy Place with a young bull . . . . . . for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering
verses.literalPt: Com isto Arão entrará no santuário: com um novilho, para expiação do pecado, e um carneiro para holocausto.

verses.original: כְּתֹֽנֶת־ בַּ֨ד קֹ֜דֶשׁ יִלְבָּ֗שׁ וּמִֽכְנְסֵי־ בַד֮ יִהְי֣וּ עַל־ בְּשָׂרוֹ֒ וּבְאַבְנֵ֥ט בַּד֙ יַחְגֹּ֔ר וּבְמִצְנֶ֥פֶת בַּ֖ד יִצְנֹ֑ף בִּגְדֵי־ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֔ם וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֛יִם אֶת־ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ וּלְבֵשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ṯō·neṯ- baḏ qō·ḏeš yil·bāš ū·miḵ·nə·sê- ḇaḏ yih·yū ‘al- bə·śā·rōw ū·ḇə·’aḇ·nêṭ baḏ yaḥ·gōr ū·ḇə·miṣ·ne·p̄eṯ baḏ yiṣ·nōp̄ biḡ·ḏê- qō·ḏeš hêm wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim ’eṯ- bə·śā·rōw ū·lə·ḇê·šām
verses.literal: He is to wear the sacred linen tunic with linen undergarments - He must tie a linen sash around him and put on the linen turban These are holy garments and he must bathe himself with water before he wears them
verses.literalPt: Vestirá ele a túnica santa de linho, e terá ceroulas de linho sobre a sua carne, e cingir-se-á com um cinto de linho, e se cobrirá com uma mitra de linho; estas são vestes santas; por isso banhará a sua carne na água, e as vestirá.

verses.original: וּמֵאֵ֗ת עֲדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יִקַּ֛ח שְׁנֵֽי־ שְׂעִירֵ֥י עִזִּ֖ים לְחַטָּ֑את וְאַ֥יִל אֶחָ֖ד לְעֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·’êṯ ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl yiq·qaḥ šə·nê- śə·‘î·rê ‘iz·zîm lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·’a·yil ’e·ḥāḏ lə·‘ō·lāh
verses.literal: And he shall take from the congregation . . . of Israel two male goats . . . for a sin offering and one ram for a burnt offering
verses.literalPt: E da congregação dos filhos de Israel tomará dois bodes para expiação do pecado e um carneiro para holocausto.

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֧יב אַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶת־ פַּ֥ר הַחַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר־ ל֑וֹ וְכִפֶּ֥ר בַּעֲד֖וֹ וּבְעַ֥ד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·rîḇ ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- par ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ’ă·šer- lōw wə·ḵip·per ba·‘ă·ḏōw ū·ḇə·‘aḏ bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: Aaron is to present the bull for his sin offering and make atonement for himself and his household
verses.literalPt: Depois Arão oferecerá o novilho da expiação, que será para ele; e fará expiação por si e pela sua casa.

verses.original: וְלָקַ֖ח אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֣י הַשְּׂעִירִ֑ם וְהֶעֱמִ֤יד אֹתָם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ ’eṯ- šə·nê haś·śə·‘î·rim wə·he·‘ĕ·mîḏ ’ō·ṯām lip̄·nê Yah·weh pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Then he shall take the two goats and present them before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: Também tomará ambos os bodes, e os porá perante o SENHOR, à porta da tenda da congregação.

verses.original: וְנָתַ֧ן אַהֲרֹ֛ן עַל־ שְׁנֵ֥י הַשְּׂעִירִ֖ם גּוֹרָל֑וֹת גּוֹרָ֤ל אֶחָד֙ לַיהוָ֔ה וְגוֹרָ֥ל אֶחָ֖ד לַעֲזָאזֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯan ’a·hă·rōn ‘al- šə·nê haś·śə·‘î·rim gō·w·rā·lō·wṯ gō·w·rāl ’e·ḥāḏ Yah·weh wə·ḡō·w·rāl ’e·ḥāḏ la·‘ă·zā·zêl
verses.literal: After Aaron casts lots for the two goats one for the LORD . . . and the other for the scapegoat
verses.literalPt: E Arão lançará sortes sobre os dois bodes; uma pelo SENHOR, e a outra pelo bode emissário.

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֤יב אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת־ הַשָּׂעִ֔יר אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָלָ֥ה עָלָ֛יו הַגּוֹרָ֖ל לַיהוָ֑ה וְעָשָׂ֖הוּ חַטָּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·rîḇ ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- haś·śā·‘îr ’ă·šer ‘ā·lāh ‘ā·lāw hag·gō·w·rāl Yah·weh wə·‘ā·śā·hū ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: he shall present the goat chosen . . . by lot for the LORD and sacrifice it as a sin offering
verses.literalPt: Então Arão fará chegar o bode, sobre o qual cair a sorte pelo SENHOR, e o oferecerá para expiação do pecado.

verses.original: וְהַשָּׂעִ֗יר אֲשֶׁר֩ עָלָ֨ה עָלָ֤יו הַגּוֹרָל֙ לַעֲזָאזֵ֔ל יָֽעֳמַד־ חַ֛י לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְכַפֵּ֣ר עָלָ֑יו לְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֹת֛וֹ לַעֲזָאזֵ֖ל הַמִּדְבָּֽרָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haś·śā·‘îr ’ă·šer ‘ā·lāh ‘ā·lāw hag·gō·w·rāl la·‘ă·zā·zêl yā·‘o·maḏ- ḥay lip̄·nê Yah·weh lə·ḵap·pêr ‘ā·lāw lə·šal·laḥ ’ō·ṯōw la·‘ă·zā·zêl ham·miḏ·bā·rāh
verses.literal: But the goat chosen by lot as the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the LORD to make atonement . . . by sending it into the wilderness as the scapegoat
verses.literalPt: Mas o bode, sobre que cair a sorte para ser bode emissário, apresentar-se-á vivo perante o SENHOR, para fazer expiação com ele, a fim de enviá-lo ao deserto como bode emissário.

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֨יב אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־ פַּ֤ר הַֽחַטָּאת֙ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֔וֹ וְכִפֶּ֥ר בַּֽעֲד֖וֹ וּבְעַ֣ד בֵּית֑וֹ וְשָׁחַ֛ט אֶת־ פַּ֥ר הַֽחַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·rîḇ ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- par ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ’ă·šer- lōw wə·ḵip·per ba·‘ă·ḏōw ū·ḇə·‘aḏ bê·ṯōw wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- par ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ’ă·šer- lōw
verses.literal: When Aaron presents the bull for his sin offering and makes atonement for himself . . . and his household he is to slaughter the bull for his own sin offering
verses.literalPt: E Arão fará chegar o novilho da expiação, que será por ele, e fará expiação por si e pela sua casa; e degolará o novilho da sua expiação.

verses.original: וְלָקַ֣ח מְלֹֽא־ הַ֠מַּחְתָּה גַּֽחֲלֵי־ אֵ֞שׁ מֵעַ֤ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּמְלֹ֣א חָפְנָ֔יו קְטֹ֥רֶת סַמִּ֖ים דַּקָּ֑ה וְהֵבִ֖יא מִבֵּ֥ית לַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ mə·lō- ham·maḥ·tāh ga·ḥă·lê- ’êš mê·‘al ham·miz·bê·aḥ mil·lip̄·nê Yah·weh ū·mə·lō ḥā·p̄ə·nāw qə·ṭō·reṯ sam·mîm daq·qāh wə·hê·ḇî mib·bêṯ lap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ
verses.literal: Then he must take a censer full of burning coals from the altar before the LORD and two handfuls . . . of finely ground fragrant incense and take them inside the veil
verses.literalPt: Tomará também o incensário cheio de brasas de fogo do altar, de diante do SENHOR, e os seus punhos cheios de incenso aromático moído, e o levará para dentro do véu.

verses.original: וְנָתַ֧ן אֶֽת־ הַקְּטֹ֛רֶת עַל־ הָאֵ֖שׁ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְכִסָּ֣ה׀ עֲנַ֣ן הַקְּטֹ֗רֶת אֶת־ הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ הָעֵד֖וּת וְלֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯan ’eṯ- haq·qə·ṭō·reṯ ‘al- hā·’êš lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·ḵis·sāh ‘ă·nan haq·qə·ṭō·reṯ ’eṯ- hak·kap·pō·reṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- hā·‘ê·ḏūṯ wə·lō yā·mūṯ
verses.literal: He is to put the incense on the fire before the LORD and the cloud of incense will cover the mercy seat above the Testimony so that he will not die
verses.literalPt: E porá o incenso sobre o fogo perante o SENHOR, e a nuvem do incenso cobrirá o propiciatório, que está sobre o testemunho, para que não morra.

verses.original: וְלָקַח֙ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֔ר וְהִזָּ֧ה בְאֶצְבָּע֛וֹ עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַכַּפֹּ֖רֶת קֵ֑דְמָה וְלִפְנֵ֣י הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת יַזֶּ֧ה שֶֽׁבַע־ פְּעָמִ֛ים מִן־ הַדָּ֖ם בְּאֶצְבָּעֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ mid·dam hap·pār wə·hiz·zāh ḇə·’eṣ·bā·‘ōw ‘al- pə·nê hak·kap·pō·reṯ qê·ḏə·māh wə·lip̄·nê hak·kap·pō·reṯ yaz·zeh še·ḇa‘- pə·‘ā·mîm min- had·dām bə·’eṣ·bā·‘ōw
verses.literal: And he is to take some of the bull’s blood and sprinkle it with his finger on the east side of the mercy seat then he shall sprinkle some of it with his finger seven times before the mercy seat
verses.literalPt: E tomará do sangue do novilho, e com o seu dedo espargirá sobre a face do propiciatório, para o lado oriental; e perante o propiciatório espargirá sete vezes do sangue com o seu dedo.

verses.original: וְשָׁחַ֞ט אֶת־ שְׂעִ֤יר הַֽחַטָּאת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָעָ֔ם וְהֵבִיא֙ אֶת־ דָּמ֔וֹ אֶל־ מִבֵּ֖ית לַפָּרֹ֑כֶת וְעָשָׂ֣ה אֶת־ דָּמ֗וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לְדַ֣ם הַפָּ֔ר וְהִזָּ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ עַל־ הַכַּפֹּ֖רֶת וְלִפְנֵ֥י הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- śə·‘îr ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ’ă·šer lā·‘ām wə·hê·ḇî ’eṯ- dā·mōw ’el- mib·bêṯ lap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ wə·‘ā·śāh ’eṯ- dā·mōw ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lə·ḏam hap·pār wə·hiz·zāh ’ō·ṯōw ‘al- hak·kap·pō·reṯ wə·lip̄·nê hak·kap·pō·reṯ
verses.literal: Aaron shall then slaughter the goat for the sin offering for the people and bring its blood . . . behind the veil . . . and with its blood he must do as he did with the bull’s blood He is to sprinkle it against the mercy seat and in front of it
verses.literalPt: Depois degolará o bode, da expiação, que será pelo povo, e trará o seu sangue para dentro do véu; e fará com o seu sangue como fez com o sangue do novilho, e o espargirá sobre o propiciatório, e perante a face do propiciatório.

verses.original: וְכִפֶּ֣ר עַל־ הַקֹּ֗דֶשׁ מִטֻּמְאֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִפִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֖ם לְכָל־ חַטֹּאתָ֑ם וְכֵ֤ן יַעֲשֶׂה֙ לְאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד הַשֹּׁכֵ֣ן אִתָּ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ טֻמְאֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵip·per ‘al- haq·qō·ḏeš miṭ·ṭum·’ōṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ū·mip·piš·‘ê·hem lə·ḵāl ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯām wə·ḵên ya·‘ă·śeh lə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ haš·šō·ḵên ’it·tām bə·ṯō·wḵ ṭum·’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: So he shall make atonement for the Most Holy Place because of the impurities and rebellious acts of the Israelites in regard to all their sins He is to do the same for the Tent of Meeting which abides among them in the midst of their impurities
verses.literalPt: Assim fará expiação pelo santuário por causa das imundícias dos filhos de Israel e das suas transgressões, e de todos os seus pecados; e assim fará para a tenda da congregação que reside com eles no meio das suas imundícias.

verses.original: וְכָל־ אָדָ֞ם לֹא־ יִהְיֶ֣ה׀ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד בְּבֹא֛וֹ לְכַפֵּ֥ר בַּקֹּ֖דֶשׁ עַד־ צֵאת֑וֹ וְכִפֶּ֤ר בַּעֲדוֹ֙ וּבְעַ֣ד בֵּית֔וֹ וּבְעַ֖ד כָּל־ קְהַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl ’ā·ḏām lō- yih·yeh bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ bə·ḇō·’ōw lə·ḵap·pêr baq·qō·ḏeš ‘aḏ- ṣê·ṯōw wə·ḵip·per ba·‘ă·ḏōw ū·ḇə·‘aḏ bê·ṯōw ū·ḇə·‘aḏ kāl- qə·hal yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: No . . . one may be in the Tent of Meeting from the time Aaron goes in to make atonement in the Most Holy Place until he leaves after he has made atonement for himself . . . his household . . . and the whole assembly of Israel
verses.literalPt: E nenhum homem estará na tenda da congregação quando ele entrar para fazer expiação no santuário, até que ele saia, depois de feita expiação por si mesmo, e pela sua casa, e por toda a congregação de Israel.

verses.original: וְיָצָ֗א אֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִפְנֵֽי־ יְהוָ֖ה וְכִפֶּ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וְלָקַ֞ח מִדַּ֤ם הַפָּר֙ וּמִדַּ֣ם הַשָּׂעִ֔יר וְנָתַ֛ן עַל־ קַרְנ֥וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ṣā ’el- ham·miz·bê·aḥ ’ă·šer lip̄·nê- Yah·weh wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·lāw wə·lā·qaḥ mid·dam hap·pār ū·mid·dam haś·śā·‘îr wə·nā·ṯan ‘al- qar·nō·wṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Then he shall go out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it He is to take some of the bull’s blood and some of the goat’s blood and put it on all the horns of the altar
verses.literalPt: Então sairá ao altar, que está perante o SENHOR, e fará expiação por ele; e tomará do sangue do novilho, e do sangue do bode, e o porá sobre as pontas do altar ao redor.

verses.original: וְהִזָּ֨ה עָלָ֧יו מִן־ הַדָּ֛ם בְּאֶצְבָּע֖וֹ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְטִהֲר֣וֹ וְקִדְּשׁ֔וֹ מִטֻּמְאֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiz·zāh ‘ā·lāw min- had·dām bə·’eṣ·bā·‘ōw še·ḇa‘ pə·‘ā·mîm wə·ṭi·hă·rōw wə·qid·də·šōw miṭ·ṭum·’ōṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: He is to sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times to cleanse it and consecrate it from the uncleanness of the Israelites
verses.literalPt: E daquele sangue espargirá sobre o altar, com o seu dedo, sete vezes, e o purificará das imundícias dos filhos de Israel, e o santificará.

verses.original: וְכִלָּה֙ מִכַּפֵּ֣ר אֶת־ הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֶת־ אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְהִקְרִ֖יב אֶת־ הַשָּׂעִ֥יר הֶחָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵil·lāh mik·kap·pêr ’eṯ- haq·qō·ḏeš wə·’eṯ- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·’eṯ- ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·hiq·rîḇ ’eṯ- haś·śā·‘îr he·ḥāy
verses.literal: When Aaron has finished purifying the Most Holy Place the Tent of Meeting and the altar he is to bring forward the live goat
verses.literalPt: Havendo, pois, acabado de fazer expiação pelo santuário, e pela tenda da congregação, e pelo altar, então fará chegar o bode vivo.

verses.original: וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־ שְׁתֵּ֣י יָדוֹ עַ֨ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר֮ הַחַי֒ וְהִתְוַדָּ֣ה עָלָ֗יו אֶת־ כָּל־ עֲוֺנֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת־ כָּל־ פִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֖ם לְכָל־ חַטֹּאתָ֑ם וְנָתַ֤ן אֹתָם֙ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׂעִ֔יר וְשִׁלַּ֛ח בְּיַד־ אִ֥ישׁ עִתִּ֖י הַמִּדְבָּֽרָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·sā·maḵ ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- šə·tê yå̄·ḏō ‘al rōš haś·śā·‘îr ha·ḥay wə·hiṯ·wad·dāh ‘ā·lāw ’eṯ- kāl- ‘ă·wō·nōṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’eṯ- kāl- piš·‘ê·hem lə·ḵāl ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯām wə·nā·ṯan ’ō·ṯām ‘al- rōš haś·śā·‘îr wə·šil·laḥ bə·yaḏ- ’îš ‘it·tî ham·miḏ·bā·rāh
verses.literal: Then he is to lay both hands on the head of the live goat and confess over it all the iniquities and rebellious acts of the Israelites in regard to all their sins He is to put them on the goat’s head and send it away into the wilderness by the hand of a man appointed for the task
verses.literalPt: E Arão porá ambas as suas mãos sobre a cabeça do bode vivo, e sobre ele confessará todas as iniqüidades dos filhos de Israel, e todas as suas transgressões, e todos os seus pecados; e os porá sobre a cabeça do bode, e enviá-lo-á ao deserto, pela mão de um homem designado para isso.

verses.original: וְנָשָׂ֨א הַשָּׂעִ֥יר עָלָ֛יו אֶת־ כָּל־ עֲוֺנֹתָ֖ם אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ גְּזֵרָ֑ה וְשִׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־ הַשָּׂעִ֖יר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·śā haś·śā·‘îr ‘ā·lāw ’eṯ- kāl- ‘ă·wō·nō·ṯām ’el- ’e·reṣ gə·zê·rāh wə·šil·laḥ ’eṯ- haś·śā·‘îr bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: The goat will carry on itself all their iniquities into a solitary place and the man will release it into the wilderness
verses.literalPt: Assim aquele bode levará sobre si todas as iniqüidades deles à terra solitária; e deixará o bode no deserto.

verses.original: וּבָ֤א אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּפָשַׁט֙ אֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֣י הַבָּ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָבַ֖שׁ בְּבֹא֣וֹ אֶל־ הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְהִנִּיחָ֖ם שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā ’a·hă·rōn ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ū·p̄ā·šaṭ ’eṯ- biḡ·ḏê hab·bāḏ ’ă·šer lā·ḇaš bə·ḇō·’ōw ’el- haq·qō·ḏeš wə·hin·nî·ḥām šām
verses.literal: Then Aaron is to enter . . . the Tent of Meeting take off the linen garments he put on before entering . . . the Most Holy Place and leave them there
verses.literalPt: Depois Arão virá à tenda da congregação, e despirá as vestes de linho, que havia vestido quando entrara no santuário, e ali as deixará.

verses.original: וְרָחַ֨ץ אֶת־ בְּשָׂר֤וֹ בַמַּ֙יִם֙ בְּמָק֣וֹם קָד֔וֹשׁ וְלָבַ֖שׁ אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֑יו וְיָצָ֗א וְעָשָׂ֤ה אֶת־ עֹֽלָתוֹ֙ וְאֶת־ עֹלַ֣ת הָעָ֔ם וְכִפֶּ֥ר בַּעֲד֖וֹ וּבְעַ֥ד הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·ḥaṣ ’eṯ- bə·śā·rōw ḇam·ma·yim bə·mā·qō·wm qā·ḏō·wōš wə·lā·ḇaš ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·yā·ṣā wə·‘ā·śāh ’eṯ- ‘ō·lā·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- ‘ō·laṯ hā·‘ām wə·ḵip·per ba·‘ă·ḏōw ū·ḇə·‘aḏ hā·‘ām
verses.literal: He is to bathe himself with water in a holy place and put on his own clothes Then he must go out and sacrifice his burnt offering and the people’s burnt offering to make atonement for himself and for the people
verses.literalPt: E banhará a sua carne em água no lugar santo, e vestirá as suas vestes; então sairá e preparará o seu holocausto, e o holocausto do povo, e fará expiação por si e pelo povo.

verses.original: וְאֵ֛ת חֵ֥לֶב הַֽחַטָּ֖את יַקְטִ֥יר הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ḥê·leḇ ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ yaq·ṭîr ham·miz·bê·ḥāh
verses.literal: He is also to burn the fat of the sin offering on the altar
verses.literalPt: Também queimará a gordura da expiação do pecado sobre o altar.

verses.original: וְהַֽמְשַׁלֵּ֤חַ אֶת־ הַשָּׂעִיר֙ לַֽעֲזָאזֵ֔ל יְכַבֵּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֔יו וְרָחַ֥ץ אֶת־ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בַּמָּ֑יִם וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֖ן יָב֥וֹא אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·šal·lê·aḥ ’eṯ- haś·śā·‘îr la·‘ă·zā·zêl yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ ’eṯ- bə·śā·rōw bam·mā·yim wə·’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên yā·ḇō·w ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: The man who released the goat as the scapegoat must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water afterward . . . he may reenter . . . the camp
verses.literalPt: E aquele que tiver levado o bode emissário lavará as suas vestes, e banhará a sua carne em água; e depois entrará no arraial.

verses.original: וְאֵת֩ פַּ֨ר הַֽחַטָּ֜את וְאֵ֣ת׀ שְׂעִ֣יר הַֽחַטָּ֗את אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוּבָ֤א אֶת־ דָּמָם֙ לְכַפֵּ֣ר בַּקֹּ֔דֶשׁ יוֹצִ֖יא אֶל־ מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְשָׂרְפ֣וּ בָאֵ֔שׁ אֶת־ עֹרֹתָ֥ם וְאֶת־ בְּשָׂרָ֖ם וְאֶת־ פִּרְשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ par ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·’êṯ śə·‘îr ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ’ă·šer hū·ḇā ’eṯ- dā·mām lə·ḵap·pêr baq·qō·ḏeš yō·w·ṣî ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh wə·śā·rə·p̄ū ḇā·’êš ’eṯ- ‘ō·rō·ṯām wə·’eṯ- bə·śā·rām wə·’eṯ- pir·šām
verses.literal: The bull for the sin offering and the goat for the sin offering whose blood was brought into the Most Holy Place to make atonement must be taken outside . . . the camp and their hides flesh and dung must be burned up . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas o novilho da expiação, e o bode da expiação do pecado, cujo sangue foi trazido para fazer expiação no santuário, serão levados fora do arraial; porém as suas peles, a sua carne, e o seu esterco queimarão com fogo.

verses.original: וְהַשֹּׂרֵ֣ף אֹתָ֔ם יְכַבֵּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֔יו וְרָחַ֥ץ אֶת־ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בַּמָּ֑יִם וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֖ן יָב֥וֹא אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haś·śō·rêp̄ ’ō·ṯām yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ ’eṯ- bə·śā·rōw bam·mā·yim wə·’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên yā·ḇō·w ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: The one who burns them must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water and afterward . . . he may reenter . . . the camp
verses.literalPt: E aquele que os queimar lavará as suas vestes, e banhará a sua carne em água; e depois entrará no arraial.

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם לְחֻקַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ֠שְּׁבִיעִי בֶּֽעָשׂ֨וֹר לַחֹ֜דֶשׁ תְּעַנּ֣וּ אֶת־ נַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶ֗ם וְכָל־ מְלָאכָה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ הָֽאֶזְרָ֔ח וְהַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֥ר בְּתוֹכְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lā·ḵem lə·ḥuq·qaṯ ‘ō·w·lām ba·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·ḇî·‘î be·‘ā·śō·wr la·ḥō·ḏeš tə·‘an·nū ’eṯ- nap̄·šō·ṯê·ḵem wə·ḵāl mə·lā·ḵāh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū hā·’ez·rāḥ wə·hag·gêr hag·gār bə·ṯō·wḵ·ḵem
verses.literal: This is to be a permanent statute for you On the tenth day of the seventh month you shall humble yourselves and not do any work whether the native or the foreigner who resides among you
verses.literalPt: E isto vos será por estatuto perpétuo: no sétimo mês, aos dez do mês, afligireis as vossas almas, e nenhum trabalho fareis nem o natural nem o estrangeiro que peregrina entre vós.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ בַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֛ה יְכַפֵּ֥ר עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם לְטַהֵ֣ר אֶתְכֶ֑ם מִכֹּל֙ חַטֹּ֣אתֵיכֶ֔ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תִּטְהָֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḇay·yō·wm haz·zeh yə·ḵap·pêr ‘ă·lê·ḵem lə·ṭa·hêr ’eṯ·ḵem mik·kōl ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯê·ḵem lip̄·nê Yah·weh tiṭ·hā·rū
verses.literal: because on this day atonement will be made for you to cleanse you and you will be clean from all your sins before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Porque naquele dia se fará expiação por vós, para purificar-vos; e sereis purificados de todos os vossos pecados perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: שַׁבַּ֨ת שַׁבָּת֥וֹן הִיא֙ לָכֶ֔ם וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת־ נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם חֻקַּ֖ת עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šab·baṯ šab·bā·ṯō·wn hî lā·ḵem wə·‘in·nî·ṯem ’eṯ- nap̄·šō·ṯê·ḵem ḥuq·qaṯ ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: It is a Sabbath of complete rest for you that you may humble yourselves it is a permanent statute
verses.literalPt: É um sábado de descanso para vós, e afligireis as vossas almas; isto é estatuto perpétuo.

verses.original: וְכִפֶּ֨ר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֲשֶׁר־ יִמְשַׁ֣ח אֹת֗וֹ וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר יְמַלֵּא֙ אֶת־ יָד֔וֹ לְכַהֵ֖ן תַּ֣חַת אָבִ֑יו וְלָבַ֛שׁ אֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֥י הַבָּ֖ד בִּגְדֵ֥י הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵip·per hak·kō·hên ’ă·šer- yim·šaḥ ’ō·ṯōw wa·’ă·šer yə·mal·lê ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw lə·ḵa·hên ta·ḥaṯ ’ā·ḇîw wə·lā·ḇaš ’eṯ- biḡ·ḏê hab·bāḏ biḡ·ḏê haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: The priest who is anointed - and ordained - to succeed . . . his father as high priest shall make atonement He will put on the sacred linen garments
verses.literalPt: E o sacerdote, que for ungido, e que for sagrado, para administrar o sacerdócio, no lugar de seu pai, fará a expiação, havendo vestido as vestes de linho, as vestes santas;

verses.original: וְכִפֶּר֙ אֶת־ מִקְדַּ֣שׁ הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֶת־ אֹ֧הֶל מוֹעֵ֛ד וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יְכַפֵּ֑ר וְעַ֧ל הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וְעַל־ כָּל־ עַ֥ם הַקָּהָ֖ל יְכַפֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵip·per ’eṯ- miq·daš haq·qō·ḏeš wə·’eṯ- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·’eṯ- ham·miz·bê·aḥ yə·ḵap·pêr wə·‘al hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·‘al- kāl- ‘am haq·qā·hāl yə·ḵap·pêr
verses.literal: and make atonement for the Most Holy Place . . . - the Tent of Meeting and the altar and for the priests . . . and all the people of the assembly
verses.literalPt: Assim fará expiação pelo santo santuário; também fará expiação pela tenda da congregação e pelo altar; semelhantemente fará expiação pelos sacerdotes e por todo o povo da congregação.

verses.original: וְהָֽיְתָה־ זֹּ֨את לָכֶ֜ם לְחֻקַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֗ם לְכַפֵּ֞ר עַל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִכָּל־ חַטֹּאתָ֔ם אַחַ֖ת בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה וַיַּ֕עַשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh- zōṯ lā·ḵem lə·ḥuq·qaṯ ‘ō·w·lām lə·ḵap·pêr ‘al- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl mik·kāl ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯām ’a·ḥaṯ baš·šā·nāh way·ya·‘aś ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: This is to be a permanent statute for you to make atonement once a year for the Israelites . . . because of all their sins And all this was done as the LORD had commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: E isto vos será por estatuto perpétuo, para fazer expiação pelos filhos de Israel de todos os seus pecados, uma vez no ano. E fez Arão como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.
